g.title: What happens to a feature branch afterwards
g.text: What happens to a feature branch afterwards
Metadata is small and useful: kept for a while · artifacts and images are big: deleted soon · main is the record: kept

g.title: cluster_legend_frame
g.text: The feature branch is deleted (after the merge, or abandoned): GitHub sends a delete event
The cleanup job deletes the branch's images from ECR at once and tags its MLflow runs with the deletion date
A daily job removes feature runs 30 days after their branch was deleted (metadata: parameters, metrics, tags)
An S3 lifecycle rule deletes dev artifacts (weights, checkpoints) after 14 days
Safety nets: an ECR lifecycle rule expires feat-* images after 14 days; Argo removes finished workflows after a few days
Kept: main images, main runs and registered models, the record of what was trained and shipped

g.title: a3d2d86dc2734be5af534d52546d8179
g.text: S3 dev/: 14 days · ECR feat-*: 14 days
Argo finished workflows: a few days
